title: What's Going on With Amazon Stock? | AMZN Stock Deep Dive Part 1
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks why Amazon shares are flat despite a strong quarter: revenue of $202 billion, up 12% year over year, and operating profit up 61% to over $28 billion. The driver is AWS, up 39.3% with operating margins approaching 40%, and the AWS backlog has grown by triple digits to over $578 billion, with demand exceeding supply for at least another year and a half. He gives two reasons the market is unimpressed: scepticism that Anthropic, OpenAI and other backlog customers will have the cash to pay and make good on the contracts, and the fact Amazon must spend hundreds of billions of dollars this year and next to build the capacity to deliver that revenue. He illustrates it with a restaurant that doubles profit only by opening five times as many locations. He also notes broader pessimism, with S&P 500 earnings up nearly 30% in 2026 while the index is only up about 10%, and says he is excited for Nvidia's results around 17 November, which he will cover live for channel members. No explicit call in this video; his 2 November AMZN BUY stands unchanged.
